task_summary: Diagnose and fix performance issues in a slow Next.js e-commerce app focusing on API route optimization, bundle size reduction, and excessive re-rendering
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct performance domains explicitly called out: API routes (backend slowness, artificial delays, sequential fetches), bundle/rendering (excessive client-side code, missing memoization, unnecessary re-renders), and Next.js-specific patterns (useEffect fetching, dynamic imports, client boundaries). These map cleanly to three skills with clear boundaries.

skills.name: evo-nextjs-api-optimization
skills.description: Identifies and fixes performance anti-patterns in Next.js API routes including artificial delays (setTimeout in production), N+1 sequential fetch patterns, missing caching headers, and unnecessary data processing. Use this skill to diagnose slow API responses.
skills.responsibility: API route performance: remove artificial delays, parallelize sequential awaits with Promise.all, add caching (fetch options, Cache-Control headers, in-memory LRU), and optimize data fetching patterns in route handlers
dr_sections: Detecting and Fixing N+1 Query Patterns

skills.name: evo-nextjs-bundle-reduction
skills.description: Identifies and fixes bundle size issues including wildcard/barrel imports, missing dynamic imports for heavy components, unnecessary 'use client' directives pushing large trees to client, and useEffect-based data fetching that should be server-side. Use this to reduce JavaScript payload and improve load times.
skills.responsibility: Client bundle optimization: tree-shake heavy imports (lodash, icons), apply next/dynamic for code splitting, minimize 'use client' boundary scope, convert client-side useEffect fetches to server-side patterns

skills.name: evo-nextjs-render-optimization
skills.description: Identifies and fixes excessive React re-rendering issues including missing React.memo, unmemoized objects/functions/computations passed as props, context overloading causing cascading re-renders, and missing/incorrect key props. Use this to fix slow interactions like cart updates and compare page rendering.
skills.responsibility: React rendering performance: add useMemo/useCallback for expensive computations and callback stability, apply React.memo to frequently re-rendered components, split overloaded contexts, fix key prop issues in lists
dr_sections: 5. Common Anti-Patterns in Slow Next.js E-commerce Apps
